text:
alan (eng-platform): proposal: add a tiny 'provenance' CSV for the cost card export. one daily row per route with tokens, cache-est, sku, routing_reason, and allocation_method. keeps invoices simple.

rhea (product): yes please. customers want one file they can hand to finance. keep column names stable.

chao (eng-telemetry): telemetry constraints: sample rates vary. we'll include sample_rate and a derived_flag. if derived_flag=true include correction_factor and raw_sample_count.

gita (billing): must include pricing_version and primary_tag. also require billing role for full-tenant downloads. route-scoped downloads ok for devs.

margo (design): UI: small link "Download provenance CSV" in the cost modal. default hide dollars; show tokens. show an amber dot + "estimated" when derived_flag=true.

alan (eng-platform): enum for routing_reason: [normal, quota_reroute, region_fallback, canary_split, manual_override]. small machine-readable string in the CSV.

chao (eng-telemetry): precompute plan: nightly job writes per-tenant/per-route/day rows: date, tenant_id, route_id, primary_tag, sku, token_burn, tokens_saved_est, shared_prefetch_pct, routing_reason, sample_rate, derived_flag, correction_factor, pricing_version. CSV endpoint pulls these rows and streams a CSV.

gita (billing): include dollars_saved_est too (materialized from nightly pricing snapshot). auditors need direct reconciliation.

rhea (product): UX nuance: when shared_prefetch_pct > 10% add a small note in CSV header: "Shared prefetch allocation used: proportional_by_hits" and in modal show details.

alan (eng-platform): security: rate-limit CSV endpoint and require billing role for full exports. export-bot will stamp the job id into the CSV for traceability.

export-bot: export queued -> provenance-export v1 -> staging. initiated by @alan.

chao (eng-telemetry): I'll post the draft SQL in the RFC. start with 1% sample upsampling but include raw counts so we can iterate.

gita (billing): once staging data looks good, schedule a 1:1 sanity check with finance.

alan (eng-platform): timeline: API + job PR this week, CSV endpoint + UI link next sprint, internal beta with billing after. I'll open the RFC and attach sample tenant_ids. thanks! :rocket:
